stem:
Amir believes that 20% of the students at his college are left-handed. His friend believes that the true proportion, $p$, is less than 20%. Amir plans to use the binomial distribution to test the null hypothesis, $\text{H}_0$: $p = 0.2$, against the alternative hypothesis, $\text{H}_1$: $p < 0.2$.

He decides to choose 35 students at random. If 3 or fewer of these students are left-handed, Amir will reject his belief.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the significance level of the test.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem: It is now given that the true value of $p$ is 0.05.
parts.text: Find the probability of a Type II error.
